# SYNESIS_E137 — Error

## Description

extraction: `field_name` is already produced by `extraction`.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
`extraction`: the field `field_name` is already produced by `extraction`.
  Each field is produced by a single phase.
```
